pkgmetadata.longdescription: Helios is a trustless, efficient Ethereum light client from a16z. It verifies chain data against a committee sync, so reads can be checked rather than trusted. net-p2p/qeth uses it as an optional sidecar for verified reads (enable the "helios" USE flag on qeth). This package installs the upstream prebuilt linux/amd64 binary to /usr/bin/helios, where qeth auto-detects it on PATH.
